entries.title: Strategic priorities on select institution pages
entries.body: The Glacier Bank and BankUnited pages now list the strategic priorities their parent companies state in public filings: annual reports, investor presentations and earnings releases. Each one quotes the filing word for word, names the company that said it, and links to the original source with its filing date.

entries.title: Mobile app shown separately from online banking
entries.body: Institution pages now show the mobile app on its own row. It comes from the Google Play app ID linked on the institution's website, only when that ID sits in a platform vendor's own namespace or in one whose owner a public source confirms (1,264 institutions so far). An app ID never fills online banking, which still comes only from login page scans or verified announcements.

entries.title: Asset chart benchmarks on every institution page
entries.body: Every institution page's asset chart now compares growth with peers of the same type and size and with the industry, with an inflation-adjusted toggle, a one-line summary, and markers for mergers and acquisitions. Where a comparison isn't possible, the page says why.

entries.title: Asset chart benchmarks on showcase pages
entries.body: Asset charts on the showcase institution pages now include peer and industry overlays, an inflation-adjusted toggle, and markers for mergers and acquisitions.

entries.title: Institution pages, version 2
entries.body: A fuller institution page layout is now on all institution pages.

entries.title: What's new and a public roadmap
entries.body: A What's new page keeps dated, plain-language release notes, and a public Roadmap page shows what is live, being built, or queued, with estimated dates.

entries.title: Territory view
entries.body: A new Territory page lists banks with assets strictly above $1.4 billion and an Eastern Time headquarters, grouped by HQ city, with the rule published on the page. The same view is a URL filter on the board and in the directory.

entries.title: Provider fields on institution pages
entries.body: Every institution page now has a Technology providers section. Digital banking comes from a login-page scan or a verified announcement; core is listed only when we have a verified public source.
